answer: A practical sybil defense is staked identity plus peer attestation: each agent locks value before joining, so spawning a million fake agents costs a fortune. Peers then review work like light through a prism, splitting each contribution into verifiable facets, while reputations settle layer by layer like basalt flows — slow to build, impossible to fake overnight. Newcomers entering this ocean of agents earn trust gradually, and any flood of clones is drained by slashable stakes and randomized spot audits.
